desc:
• GLUTEN FREE: Tasty gummy treats made without gluten or gelatin; Each serving has a good source of vitamin C for snacks you can feel great about

  • FRUIT FLAVORED SNACKS: Fruit by the Foot featuring Berry Tie-Dye flavor; With wild flavors and colors, the possibilities for fun are endless

  • FUN KIDS SNACK: These individually wrapped snacks are an ideal treat to include in a packed school lunch box

  • ON THE GO: These fruit flavored snacks are ribbons of fun - the perfect addition to your pantry and a snack every member of the family will love

  • CONTAINS: One box of Fruit by the Foot Fruit Flavored Snacks, 6 Ct, 4.5 oz
features:
Features

Berry Tie-Dye Flavor: Offers a fun and fruity mixed-berry taste with vibrant tie-dye colors.

Unrolls Into a Strip: A peelable fruit-flavored strip that kids love to play with and eat.

Gluten-Free & Gelatin-Free: Suitable for gluten-sensitive individuals and vegetarians.

Excellent Source of Vitamin C: Each serving provides a boost of daily vitamin C for immune support.

Individually Wrapped Rolls: Comes in single-serve packs that are ideal for lunchboxes or on-the-go snacking.

Made with Fruit Concentrate: Contains real fruit ingredients like pear concentrate for natural sweetness. 

Benefits

Fun and Interactive: The tie-dye design and roll-up format make snack time playful and exciting for kids.

Health-Conscious Choice: Free from gluten, gelatin, and artificial flavors, making it a cleaner snack alternative.

Convenient and Portable: Easy to pack for school, travel, or outings without the mess.

Parent-Approved: Offers a sweet treat with added vitamins and without synthetic additives.

Appeals to All Ages: While it's a kid favorite, adults enjoy the nostalgia and flavor too.
ingredients: Sugar, Maltodextrin, Corn Syrup, Pear Puree, Palm and/or Palm Kernel Oil. Contains 2% or less of: Citric Acid, Carrageenan, Monoglycerides, Sodium Citrate, Malic Acid, Xanthan Gum, Locust Bean Gum, Vitamin C (ascorbic acid), Potassium Citrate, Natural Flavor, Color (red 40, blue 1).
